newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-CROATIA DEFENDER BRAJKOVIC JOINS VERONA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CROATIA DEFENDER BRAJKOVIC JOINS VERONA.

text.p: Croat international defender Elvis Brajkovic joined Italian serie A club Verona on Monday, saying he hoped to help steer the struggling side to safety from threatened relegation.
"I know that Verona are not sailing in calm waters but I believe we can reach safety," the 26-year-old defender said at a formal presentation organised by the club.
Brajkovic joined on loan from German Bundesliga club Munich 1860 after a spell at Rijeka in Croatia.
Verona, promoted from serie B last season, are just one point ahead of bottom club Reggiana. They drew 1-1 with Lazio at the weekend and play at resurgent Parma on Sunday.
